title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. translated_title: PDDLCoder：面向LLM辅助符号规划的智能体式PDDL生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16637v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）在长时程规划中仍不可靠，常常生成逻辑不一致或不可执行的计划。最近的混合方法转而将自然语言翻译成规划领域定义语言（PDDL），使符号规划器能够生成可验证的计划。然而，现有方法往往依赖僵化的生成流程、不完整的PDDL定义或人工反馈。此外，它们的评估因缺乏具有自动验证功能的标准基准而受到阻碍。为解决这些局限，我们提出了PDDLCoder，一个从自然语言生成PDDL的智能体框架，能够迭代地生成、分析和优化规划规范。我们进一步引入了NL-pddlgym，一个基准数据集，包含23个领域的711个规划问题，并提供可执行的gym环境用于计划适用性的自动验证。在包含106个问题的NL-pddlgym测试集上的实验表明，PDDLCoder显著优于现有基线，展示了其在实现可靠符号规划方面的有效性。
tldr: PDDLCoder是一个智能体框架，通过迭代生成、分析和优化PDDL规范，从自然语言中自动生成可验证的规划，并引入NL-pddlgym基准数据集以支持自动评估。
en_tdlr: PDDLCoder is an agentic framework that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines PDDL specifications from natural language for verifiable symbolic planning, introducing the NL-pddlgym benchmark for automated evaluation.
